title: Two-tier Agent Mail identity model — doctrine + wiring (ratified 2026-07-14)
description:
DECISION (Craig, 2026-07-14, this session): adopt the TWO-TIER identity model, replacing agent-identity.md's unwired mint-or-inherit doctrine. Rationale recorded so this isn't relitigated:
- Identity is the lock grain; the grain must match the WRITER-CONCURRENCY boundary. At PARALLEL_WIDTH>1 the parallel ac-implement children are independent concurrent writers in one shared checkout — inheriting one loop identity would put multiple writers under one name (forbidden by agent-identity.md's own corollary). Below the boundary, workers never commit/reserve, so per-worker identity is pure ceremony. The inherit model was written for a serial world; the width dial obsoleted it.
- TIER 1 (unique minted identity — mint via macro_start_session, reserve at work grain, release, self-deregister at exit): any session that CLAIMS BEADS or EDITS PRODUCT CODE — loop conductor (claims only), each ac-implement child, ac-review (auto-fix engineer edits code), ac-batch-close (fix-forward). Plan-family skills already conform.
- TIER 2 (FoggyCreek as EXPLICIT shared chore identity, not accidental fallback): serial low-contention writers — scheduled jobs (tidy/align/dream), ac-land sweep/report commits. HARD RULE = tier boundary AND safety guard: FoggyCreek may commit chore files but may NEVER claim beads or reserve files.
- Deregistration = 3 layers: (1) minter self-deregisters at own exit; (2) ac-land sweeps the identity roster handed by the loop (VERIFIED 2026-07-14 against live schemas: deregister_agent/retire_agent take registration_token as OPTIONAL — sweep by name works; force_release_file_reservation exists for stale holds); (3) next-run Phase-0 stale sweep + reservation TTL floor.
- Claim-visibility chain (CLAIM_ASSIGNEE threading + beads-closed-gate union + fail-closed) is solid and UNCHANGED by this epic.
Audit that produced this: 5 gaps — exit-land can't release/deregister identities never handed to it; stages never deregister; agent-identity.md contradicts live per-stage model; engineer wip-commit hatch collides with pre-commit guard; FoggyCreek fallback silently misattributes claims. Children implement; doctrine-rewrite child blocks the rest.
